_comment: Opt-in typecheck for tests/integration — NOT consumed by `pnpm -r typecheck` (which iterates the workspace packages). Trigger explicitly via `pnpm run typecheck:integration`. Extends the root base so module resolution / strictness / NodeNext line up with the rest of the repo. `baseUrl` + `paths` map the workspace package names to their source `.ts` files (instead of relying on workspace symlinks, which don't exist at `tests/integration/node_modules`).
